name: 5 EMA selling side (buy put): 5-min alert candle above the 5 EMA, enter when its low breaks
why: YouTube video sent by Mandeep, 13 Nov 2026 ('5 EMA', presenter Subhashish): alert candle closes above the 5 EMA without touching it; next candle breaks its low -> short; stop = alert high; target 1:3; up to 3 entries a day. Claim: 60-70% accuracy. Index pre-test 2022-2026 (research 0004): target first only 25% (Nifty) / 23% (Bank Nifty), +1.3 / +1.9 index points a trade before option costs. Not proven.
source: Video: 5 EMA scalping (Mandeep 13 Nov 2026), Tanu research 0004
